steps.instruction: Write file skeleton. Imports: os, logging, psycopg2, RealDictCursor, dotenv, engine.base. _get_conn() EXACTLY as mandatory_patterns. Class with all attributes. Methods have 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _extract_mood(). Lowercase message. Remove triggers LONGEST FIRST: 'status update', 'im feeling', 'i feel', 'doing well', 'doing great', 'doing bad', 'check in', 'checkin', 'feeling', 'mood'. Normalize whitespace between each. The remaining text IS the mood/status. Common moods to recognize: 'happy', 'sad', 'tired', 'anxious', 'stressed', 'energized', 'grateful', 'frustrated', 'calm', 'excited'. If cleaned text is a known mood word, use it directly. Otherwise use the full cleaned text as a freeform mood. Return the mood string.

Implement _insert_checkin(). Use _get_conn(). INSERT INTO checkin_log (checkin_date, checkin_type, summary, user_response) VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, 'mood', %s, %s) RETURNING id. Params: (mood_text, original_message). conn.commit(). Return cursor.fetchone()['id']. try/finally close cursor and connection. IMPORTANT: use cursor.fetchone()['id'] NOT cursor.fetchone()[0] because RealDictCursor returns dicts.

Implement execute(). Extract mood from message. If mood is empty or < 2 chars: return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={}, summary='How are you feeling? Tell me your mood or status.', confidence=0.3, sources=[]). Call _insert_checkin(mood_text=mood, original_message=request.message). Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={'checkin_id': new_id, 'mood': mood}, summary=f'Check-in recorded: {mood}', confidence=0.95, sources=['mythos.checkin_log']). try/except/finally.
Review. _get_conn uses POSTGRES_HOST. conn.commit() after INSERT. SkillResponse uses ONLY valid kwargs. Summary never empty. ASCII only. Production-ready.
